commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

90+2' Great solo effort from Joshua King (Toulouse)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' 1 - 3 Geronimo Rulli is stranded way out of his goal after his team loses possession and Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) has the simplest of tasks to shoot the ball into an empty net from distance. It’s now 1:3.
